content: We evaluate fairness of classification with respect to two groups - samples with age INLINEFORM0 60 and those with age INLINEFORM1 60. A fair classifier would produce comparable classification scores for both groups. For the best performing classifier on DB, the F1 (micro) score for samples with age INLINEFORM2 60 is 85.9% and with age INLINEFORM3 60 is 76.4%. With the addition of HA, the F1 (micro) score for samples with age INLINEFORM4 60 and with age INLINEFORM5 is more balanced (75.6%, 76.1% respectively) for the same set of data points from DB. Note that the average age in both datasets are similar ( INLINEFORM6 ).
